summary: Frontend-only E2E of the new Super Admin 'Email disponibilità eventi' section on /piattaforma (AvailabilityEmailPanel). Logged in as Super Admin manara.michele.pro@gmail.com, navigated to /piattaforma. Verified: (1) [data-testid='availability-email-panel'] renders above FunnelPanel. (2) Status badge [data-testid='availability-auto-status'] shows exactly 'Invii automatici: DISATTIVATI' (BREVO_AVAILABILITY_ENABLED off). (3) Amber warning [data-testid='availability-not-configured'] visible with copy 'Brevo non configurato in questo ambiente. La creazione dei template e l'invio reale sono disponibili in produzione.'. (4) Table [data-testid='availability-templates-table'] renders 2 rows -availability-template-row-disponibilita ('CRMEvent · Disponibilità ricevuta', tipo 'Disponibilità', Template ID '—', stato 'Non creato', updated '—') and -availability-template-row-conferma ('CRMEvent · Partecipazione confermata', tipo 'Conferma', same '—/Non creato/—'). (5) [data-testid='availability-test-event-select'] populated with 4 options from Test orgs: 'Bologna City Run 2026 — Demo', 'Green Trail Experience 2026 — Demo', 'Sunset Triathlon 2027 — Demo', 'Nova Run Festival — Nova Events'. (6) Filling [data-testid='availability-test-to-input']='test@example.com' and clicking both [data-testid='availability-send-test-disponibilita'] and [data-testid='availability-send-test-conferma'] does NOT throw any error: [data-testid='availability-test-result'] shows 'Invio non eseguito · <kind> — Brevo non configurato in questo ambiente. L'invio reale è disponibile in produzione.' and a sonner warning toast with the same copy is shown. (7) API isolation via direct fetch: GET /api/brevo/availability-templates with SA cookie → 200; POST /api/brevo/availability-test-email with SA cookie → 200 body {ok:false, configured:false, message:'Brevo non configurato...'}; both endpoints without session → 401. No console errors related to the panel; only expected 401 (auth/me pre-login) and 428 (billing gate on /app for SA) noise unrelated to the panel.

issues: Iubenda cookie banner overlays the bottom of the panel on first visit and can cover the 'Invia test' button in the second table row; accepting/rifiutando the banner resolves it. Pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: AvailabilityEmailPanel.load() catches per-request rejection but always calls setLoading(false); OK. formatApiError is invoked on t.reason?.response?.data?.detail — when the templates endpoint fails without a response (network error) the toast will render 'undefined'; consider a fallback string.
The 'Crea template in Brevo' button is disabled while !configured (correct for preview), but there is no data-testid guarantee for the 'template already present' state — kept as design decision.
sendTest uses toast.warning for r.ok===false which is exactly the required UX (no error). Confirmed working end-to-end against the mocked backend response.
